input.quote: Risk of loss for all Base Components shall at all times remain with IBM. Risk of loss for all Customer Components shall at all times remain with Customer.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance clause anywhere (no hits for "insurance"; the outline has no insurance section), yet IBM hosts the e-business Hosting Environment, holds risk of loss for Base Components (§ 14.12) and processes personal information on Customer's behalf (§ 14.18, § 5.3). Under the playbook a services/hosting vendor touching our data must carry CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M and statutory workers' compensation with certificates on request; no insurance for a vendor processing personal data is a walk-away. Inserted a short insurance paragraph as new § 14.12A adjacent to Risk of Loss, binding IBM only, with fallback limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert a new § 14.12A requiring IBM to carry CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance requirement even though IBM hosts our environment and processes data on our behalf, so we have added a standard clause (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request) immediately after Risk of Loss. If these limits are an issue we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.

ops.text: IBM shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering the Services and any Customer Components, Content or personal information processed by IBM on Customer's behalf; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. IBM shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.
